text_block_list.text:
One day, during lunch break. While looking over some 
documents, I was eating lunch in the trainers' offices……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Having lunch while working again? 
So in love with work that you're making me jealous.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I just had some questions about this afternoon's training. 
Remember? To prep for the next race we talked about 
increasing the intensity and duration of training, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And so my friends said that after their training was done, they wanted 
to come cheer me on. It might get a little rowdy, but is that okay?

Daring Heart was the type to get fired up when surrounded by cheers. 
It would be helpful in simulating an actual live race.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Really? Thanks! 
Then, I'll let them know!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Phew…… I'm all set. 
It's about time we get started!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
D・A・R・I・N・G! Heart! 
D・A・R・I・N・G! Heart! Wooo～!

I was startled by the sudden cheers. When I looked towards the stands, 
I saw a group of girls holding placards with 『Daring Heart』 on them.
choice_data_list: H-Heart? Is this what you meant……?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 
Fufu, they're great, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
——Thank you for cheering for me! 
Those cheers, I won't let them go to waste♪

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text: Whew～♪

After all that, Daring Heart and all her 
friends decided to have dinner together——however——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, buddy! 
Today, we're not going there!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend C
text_block_list.text:
——Alllright! 
Let's Happy Dinner Time☆

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No way! 
If it was, we'd put way more effort in to it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Look, we're not all in the same dorm, right? 
So this is a joint dinner we have together pretty often!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
We get tired of using only the dorm and cafeteria everyday, you know! 
……It's the same food cooked by the staff though!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu! Just by changing the location, 
it's still pretty fun, right?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
——Then, we'll be heading back first. 
Trainer-san, thanks for today!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
……Phew～. Even though tomorrow's a rest day, 
we still put too much in the menu, huh?
choice_data_list: Yeah, make sure to get a good rest
Yeah, make sure to get a good rest

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Got it! ……By the way. 
Do you have any plans tomorrow?

I tilted my head in response to the question. 
I didn't really have any specific plans other 
than staying home and reviewing some documents but……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You see, an acquaintance invited me to a garden party tomorrow. 
……If you'd like, how about coming with me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This time it's a 『Themed Party』. We'll be dressing up 
and playing games based on the theme set by the organizers.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
This time's theme is 『Spies』…… 
So we'll be like agents or SPs. How about it?

I was grateful for the invite. ……But, judging by today's 
fanfare, I would probably be well and truly out of place.

She lived in a completely different world from the 
quiet one I was used to. ……I wasn't really accustomed 
to it, so I didn't want to drag down the mood.
choice_data_list: ……It probably won't be fun with me, so——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I see. 
……Then, you're coming! Okay!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
After all, together we're running the 
Twinkle Series, so we're buddies, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I want to know more about you, 
and you need to learn more about me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And to do that, I want to spend more time with you. 
I need to experience lots of things.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Don't you think so?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: And so, can I leave the job of escort to you!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'll be there with you! 
——Yes or Hell Yes?
